premises.text: High-volume hiring with keyword/prestige-based evaluation overlooks high-potential candidates and produces false positives across diverse backgrounds
premises.evidence_span: evaluations today are based on criteria such as well-known schools or well-known companies. They favor prestige over potential

premises.text: Deep learning qualifies experiences, projects, education, and transitions on resumes, including hidden correlations traditional keyword systems miss
premises.evidence_span: Our unique deep learning technology is able to qualify every experience project, education, or transition people can write down in their resumes

premises.text: The system assesses technical and non-technical jobs, scales across languages, and handles multiple media formats
premises.evidence_span: we are able to assess both technical and non-technical jobs. We are able to scale to all languages. And finally, we can deal with all media formats, from PDF to images

premises.text: Candidate capture integrations (e.g., embeddable chatbot) simplify applications and increase candidate volume
premises.evidence_span: It allows you to capture four times more candidates by tremendously simplifying the application experience

premises.text: AI layers combine general career-path learning with company-specific custom learning, including continuous learning from recruiter actions
premises.evidence_span: we built two artificial intelligence layers. The first, it's a general layer based on the millions of career paths we analyzed. The second, it's a custom layer based on the internal data of the company

premises.text: Pricing starts low and scales with growth so recruiters can focus on emotionally intelligent tasks
premises.evidence_span: our pricing starts only at $99 and scales as you grow

value.text: Reveal candidates' full potential beyond prestige filters so recruiters find more relevant talent with fewer interviews
